summary: 已连接静默状态采样从 per-pane TTL 扇出改为 fleet-wide FIFO + token bucket：持续上界 4 次/秒、固定 burst 8；3/27/200 pane 确定性测试证明速率不随 fleet 线性增长，200 pane 配置最坏状态可见时间 55s。隔离 27-pane 真进程三态各量测 >=60s：零连接 0.000%，已连接零订阅 2.481746%，已连接单订阅 2.398631%，两个在线态均 <= 冻结 5%。

confirmed_facts.fact: 旧实现对一个已缓存且 TTL 全过期的稳定 fleet 在同一 listing 轮为每个 pane 启动采样；maxConc 只限制同时运行数，不限制总调度率。
confirmed_facts.evidence: red-first.log 是写测试后的首次红（3/27/200 pane 分别观察到 3/27/187 次）；baseline-stable-red-replay.log 又在 source_sha 的 throwaway git archive 上精确预置稳定缓存+TTL 全过期，观察到 3/27/151 次，均为 expected exit 1。

confirmed_facts.fact: defaultStateSamplingBudget=3s 仍只是单次采样 timeout 上界，不承担频率限流；频率由新增 token bucket 独立控制。
修复后已连接零订阅态持续存在 listing/state 成本，但在本轮 27 个真实 wrapper pane 中平均 CPU 2.481746%，capture-pane 3.997442/s。
修复后已连接单订阅态平均 CPU 2.398631%，capture-pane 3.997719/s；该窗口未显示单订阅带来额外持续 capture-pane 调度。
零连接态 60.042646016s 内 daemon CPU time 不增且 capture-pane 为 0。

unknowns_and_limits: FIELD 中历史 14.8% 样本的 listing 与单订阅成本占比仍不能从本轮修复后窗口反推；不报告历史百分比分摊。
历史样本来自用户现场混合 fleet，本轮来自 27 个隔离真实 wrapper pane；两者均为本机实测，但不声称 fixture 完全相同。
两个修复后在线态相差 0.083115 个百分点，不能据此声称订阅成本为负或精确为零；只确认两态均低于 5% 且持续 capture-pane 率相同。

fix.sampling: State 只做缓存读取和去重入队；一个 fleet-wide token bucket 以 250ms/token、burst 8 从 FIFO 放行，TTL 只决定 eligibility。
fix.fairness: 默认 2s listing cadence 下，首 token 后每轮最多 8；200 pane 最后首轮调度约 50s，加 3s 单次预算和下一次 2s listing，配置最坏可见时间 55s <= 60s。
fix.concurrency: maxConcurrent=16 仅覆盖 4 starts/s * 3s budget 的有界重叠；它不再被描述为频率限流。
fix.discovery_isolation: 新增 DiscoverySocketDirs nil/non-nil seam；nil 仍调用 production discovery.Discover，显式 slice 调用 DiscoverWithDirs。未改 cmd 的真 e2e 只通过 AGENTMIRROR_E2E_DISCOVERY_SOCKET_DIRS opt-in。

isolation_and_cleanup.runtime: one mktemp-owned /tmp/am-cidle.* tree, one self-owned tmux -L socket, env -i daemon/client, one 127.0.0.1 high port
isolation_and_cleanup.scoped_discovery: daemon tmux shim refused before exec for every target outside its exact socket directory; 594 self-owned tmux targets, 0 out-of-scope targets
isolation_and_cleanup.production_interaction: none: no production HTTP/WS/connect/attach/signal and no user tmux socket opened
isolation_and_cleanup.process_snapshot_deviation: ps read-only snapshot; classification only beneath self-owned pane roots; raw process table not recorded or displayed; zero production interaction

deviations: Leader approved the minimal scoped discovery consumer seam inside server/internal/api because TMUX_TMPDIR alone still makes default discovery enumerate host defaults; production nil behavior and wire API remain unchanged.
Leader approved the existing state provider's ps -axo for the real wrapper fixture under the stated read-only boundary; no global process table was logged or displayed.

The first isolated e2e attempt exited 1 because separate Python processes exposed non-comparable monotonic epochs. The harness rejected the apparent 0.009s window, produced no product verdict, and its exact temp root/port were independently confirmed gone before switching to wall-clock nanoseconds and rerunning; see e2e-first-run-red.log.
